decisions.reason: The platform, white-label mode, and client upload responsibility are already fully represented by the candidate's message-145 MODIFY.
Delivering the final PDF to the client for upload does not alter the PDF's two-page-spread compatibility or page-count rules.
The delivery artifact and recipient decision does not change the required sharpness of advertisements.
Sending the final PDF to the client does not change the approved Inter typeface, weight, or readability constraint.
The separate message-145 instruction to use only the supplied images without extra text is already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY; the PDF delivery decision adds no further change.
The final PDF delivery and client-upload responsibility do not alter the cover page-number accuracy rule.
The delivery decision does not change the table-of-contents completion timing or finalized-pagination accuracy requirement.
The delivery artifact and recipient have no effect on author names, photographs, sizing, sourcing, or placement.
Sending the final PDF to the client does not alter the article-image quality remediation requirement.
The PDF handoff and Heyzine upload responsibility do not change the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The final PDF handoff does not modify the required template, supplied layout inputs, compilation action, or Flat Plan arrangement basis.
The delivery and upload decision does not change the specified website as the source of magazine articles.
